text: The old gray mare has a very large nose. She was a cook in a school cafeteria. The dog was chased by the cat. The cat sat near the door. The students read the book and discussed the story. They learned new words and compared their ideas. The teacher explained the difficult passage. Everyone wrote a short response after the lesson.

Language changes as people use it. We learn new words in different places. A student can read a story and discuss it with a friend. The friend may notice a detail that the student missed. Their discussion helps them understand the passage. Later they write about the main idea and the examples in the text. Reading and writing both give them practice.
